name: Nonomiya Chihiro
source:
The older twin, a friendly and kind, but somewhat clumsy girl. She tries to make Souichi's homecoming as easy as possible.

[spoiler] It is later revealed that she has another sister who is Chitose and the one who made the promise. This means that the sisters are trio and not twins. [/spoiler]
